plans.idea: Classic top-down skyscraper: a centred brand lockup crowns the canvas, the headline and subhead follow as one block, then the bottle large and centred, and a modest, centred CTA closes the read, all on one central axis.

Product-first: the glowing bottle opens the column as the eye-catcher, the headline and subhead sit right under it, the CTA follows the copy closely, and the Solstice lockup signs off at the foot like a brand stamp.

Headline-led with a brand sign-off: the headline and subhead take the top third, the bottle fills the middle, and the CTA and logo are stacked as a tight closing unit at the bottom, so the message reads first and the brand last.
